templates.pattern:
What is the area of a rectangle?
Statement I: The perimeter of the rectangle is 40 cm.
Statement II: The length of the rectangle is 12 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I gives perimeter = 40, so 2(l+b) = 40, meaning l+b = 20. We still need one dimension. Statement II gives length = 12. Together: b = 20-12 = 8, Area = 12×8 = 96 cm². Both statements together are needed.

templates.pattern:
What is the circumference of a circle?
Statement I: The radius of the circle is 7 cm.
Statement II: The diameter of the circle is 14 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: circumference = 2πr = 2×π×7 = 44 cm. Statement II: diameter = 14, so radius = 7, circumference = 44 cm. Either statement alone is sufficient.

templates.pattern:
What is the area of a triangle?
Statement I: The base of the triangle is 10 cm.
Statement II: The height of the triangle is 8 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Area = ½ × base × height. Statement I gives base = 10 but height is unknown. Statement II gives height = 8 but base is unknown. Together: Area = ½ × 10 × 8 = 40 cm². Both statements together are needed.

templates.pattern:
What is the area of a square?
Statement I: The perimeter of the square is 48 cm.
Statement II: The diagonal of the square is 12√2 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: side = 48/4 = 12, Area = 144 cm². Statement II: diagonal = 12√2, side = 12, Area = 144 cm². Either statement alone is sufficient.

templates.pattern:
Is the triangle equilateral?
Statement I: All three sides of the triangle are equal.
Statement II: All three angles of the triangle are 60°.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: all sides equal directly defines an equilateral triangle. Statement II: all angles 60° also directly defines an equilateral triangle. Either statement alone is sufficient.

templates.pattern:
What is the volume of a cube?
Statement I: The surface area of the cube is 216 cm².
Statement II: The side of the cube is 6 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: 6a² = 216, a² = 36, a = 6, Volume = 216 cm³. Statement II: side = 6, Volume = 6³ = 216 cm³. Either statement alone is sufficient.

templates.pattern:
What is the area of a circle?
Statement I: The radius of the circle is 5 cm.
Statement II: The circumference of the circle is 10π cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: Area = πr² = 25π cm². Statement II: circumference = 2πr = 10π, so r = 5, Area = 25π cm². Either statement alone is sufficient.

templates.pattern:
What is the perimeter of a rectangle?
Statement I: The length of the rectangle is 15 cm.
Statement II: The breadth of the rectangle is 9 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Perimeter = 2(l+b). Statement I gives length = 15 but breadth unknown. Statement II gives breadth = 9 but length unknown. Together: Perimeter = 2(15+9) = 48 cm. Both statements together are needed.

templates.pattern:
Is the quadrilateral a square?
Statement I: All four sides of the quadrilateral are equal.
Statement II: All four angles of the quadrilateral are 90°.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I alone: all sides equal could be a rhombus — not necessarily a square. Statement II alone: all angles 90° could be a rectangle — not necessarily a square. Together: equal sides AND right angles confirm it is a square.

templates.pattern:
What is the height of a cylinder?
Statement I: The volume of the cylinder is 1540 cm³.
Statement II: The radius of the base of the cylinder is 7 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Volume = πr²h. Statement I gives volume = 1540 but radius unknown. Statement II gives radius = 7 but height unknown. Together: h = 1540/(π×49) = 10 cm. Both statements together are needed.

templates.pattern:
What is the length of the hypotenuse of a right-angled triangle?
Statement I: One leg of the triangle is 6 cm.
Statement II: The other leg of the triangle is 8 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Hypotenuse = √(a²+b²). Statement I gives one leg = 6 but the other is unknown. Statement II gives the other leg = 8 but the first is unknown. Together: hypotenuse = √(36+64) = √100 = 10 cm.

templates.pattern:
What is the area of a parallelogram?
Statement I: The base of the parallelogram is 14 cm.
Statement II: The height of the parallelogram is 6 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Area = base × height. Statement I gives base = 14 but height unknown. Statement II gives height = 6 but base unknown. Together: Area = 14 × 6 = 84 cm². Both statements together are needed.

templates.pattern:
What is the diagonal of a rectangle?
Statement I: The length of the rectangle is 12 cm.
Statement II: The breadth of the rectangle is 5 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Diagonal = √(l²+b²). Statement I gives length = 12 but breadth unknown. Statement II gives breadth = 5 but length unknown. Together: diagonal = √(144+25) = √169 = 13 cm.

templates.pattern:
What is the total surface area of a cylinder?
Statement I: The radius of the cylinder is 7 cm.
Statement II: The height of the cylinder is 10 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: TSA = 2πr(r+h). Statement I gives radius = 7 but height unknown. Statement II gives height = 10 but radius unknown. Together: TSA = 2×π×7×(7+10) = 2×π×7×17 = 748 cm². Both needed.

templates.pattern:
What is the side of an equilateral triangle?
Statement I: The perimeter of the triangle is 36 cm.
Statement II: The area of the triangle is 36√3 cm².
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: side = 36/3 = 12 cm. Statement II: area = (√3/4)a² = 36√3, so a² = 144, a = 12 cm. Either statement alone is sufficient.

templates.pattern:
What is the volume of a cone?
Statement I: The radius of the base of the cone is 7 cm.

Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Volume = (1/3)πr²h. Statement I gives radius = 7 but height unknown. Statement II gives height = 9 but radius unknown. Together: Volume = (1/3)×π×49×9 = 147π cm³. Both statements are needed.

templates.pattern:
Are two triangles similar?
Statement I: The three angles of both triangles are equal.
Statement II: The corresponding sides of both triangles are in the ratio 2:3.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: equal angles (AAA) directly proves similarity. Statement II: sides in constant ratio also proves similarity. Either statement alone is sufficient to confirm similarity.

templates.pattern:
What is the area of a trapezium?
Statement I: The two parallel sides are 8 cm and 12 cm.
Statement II: The height of the trapezium is 5 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Area = ½×(sum of parallel sides)×height. Statement I gives parallel sides = 8 and 12 but height unknown. Statement II gives height = 5 but parallel sides unknown. Together: Area = ½×20×5 = 50 cm².

templates.pattern:
What is the surface area of a sphere?
Statement I: The radius of the sphere is 6 cm.
Statement II: The diameter of the sphere is 12 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: SA = 4πr² = 4×π×36 = 144π cm². Statement II: diameter = 12, radius = 6, SA = 144π cm². Either statement alone is sufficient.

templates.pattern:
What is the perimeter of an equilateral triangle?
Statement I: One side of the triangle is 9 cm.
Statement II: The area of the triangle is (81√3)/4 cm².
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: perimeter = 3×9 = 27 cm. Statement II: area = (√3/4)a² = (81√3)/4, so a² = 81, a = 9, perimeter = 27 cm. Either statement alone is sufficient.

templates.pattern:
What is the volume of a cuboid?
Statement I: The length is 10 cm and breadth is 5 cm.
Statement II: The height of the cuboid is 4 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Volume = l×b×h. Statement I gives l = 10, b = 5 but height unknown. Statement II gives height = 4 but l and b unknown. Together: Volume = 10×5×4 = 200 cm³. Both statements are needed.

templates.pattern:
Is the given triangle a right-angled triangle?
Statement I: The sides of the triangle are 5 cm, 12 cm and 13 cm.
Statement II: The largest angle of the triangle is 90°.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Statement I: 5²+12² = 25+144 = 169 = 13² — Pythagoras theorem satisfied, so it is right-angled. Statement II: largest angle = 90° directly confirms right-angled triangle. Either statement alone is sufficient.

templates.pattern:
What is the area of a rhombus?
Statement I: One diagonal of the rhombus is 10 cm.
Statement II: The other diagonal of the rhombus is 8 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Area of rhombus = ½×d1×d2. Statement I gives d1 = 10 but d2 unknown. Statement II gives d2 = 8 but d1 unknown. Together: Area = ½×10×8 = 40 cm². Both statements are needed.

templates.pattern:
What is the slant height of a cone?
Statement I: The radius of the base is 6 cm.
Statement II: The height of the cone is 8 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Slant height = √(r²+h²). Statement I gives r = 6 but h unknown. Statement II gives h = 8 but r unknown. Together: slant height = √(36+64) = √100 = 10 cm. Both statements are needed.

templates.pattern:
What is the angle subtended by an arc at the centre of a circle?
Statement I: The length of the arc is 11 cm.
Statement II: The radius of the circle is 7 cm.
Which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question?
options: Option A: Statement I alone is sufficient
Option B: Statement II alone is sufficient
Option C: Both statements together are sufficient
Option D: Either statement alone is sufficient
templates.explanation: Angle = (arc length / circumference) × 360°. Statement I gives arc = 11 but radius unknown. Statement II gives radius = 7 but arc unknown. Together: circumference = 44, angle = (11/44)×360° = 90°. Both needed.

incorrect: Check if one or both statements are needed 🤔
